literal_meaning: পাক বা ফাঁদে পড়া বা ফেলা
figurative_meaning_en: To fall into trouble or a trap
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চালাকির ফাঁদে পাকে পড়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He fell into the trap of cunning.
He fell into the trap due to greed in business.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of hunting traps, common in rural Bengali life.
